Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter options for procurement

Hi Soojin,

Hope you're well — I'm starting Acme's procurement review for vendors supporting customer data and we'd like to request Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II report. Two quick asks: 1) Please confirm the audit period covered by the most recent Type II (start/end dates) and whether you can provide a bridge letter if the period does not fully overlap with our procurement window. 2) Can you share a short "what to provide" list (minimal artifacts) and preferred secure transfer options (presigned GCS/S3, Drive folder, or SFTP)?

Our target cutoff for our docs review is Sep 10. If you can point us to a bridge option or confirm coverage today/tomorrow that would be ideal.

Thanks — Liam
Liam O'Connor
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
liam.oconnor@acme-corp.com

Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter options for procurement

Hi Liam — thanks for the note and the timeline. Short answers up front: we can provide our latest SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter if the auditor's period does not match your required window. Below is a minimal, low-friction checklist and the options for secure delivery.

Minimal artifacts we typically share (low friction set):
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) + cover letter
- Bridge letter (PDF) if audit period differs
- Control mapping / access matrix (CSV) — redacted where necessary
- Logging/retention summary (short PDF) and sample telemetry snippets (anonymized) on request
- Contact for SOC 2 questions (security@example.com)

Preferred transfer methods (pick one):
- Temporary Drive folder (presigned link) — easiest for reviewers
- Pre-signed S3/GCS object links 
- SFTP (by request)

Audit period note: Our most recent Type II report covers 2025-07-01 through 2026-06-30. If your procurement window needs coverage beyond 2026-06-30 we will provide a bridge letter that explains coverage and any relevant compensating controls.

We can also provide a short reply template you can share with legal/procurement if they need the bridge letter to be signed or notarized. I'll attach a draft bridge letter and a minimal evidence manifest to speed things up.

Deliverables I will upload now: redwood_soc2_typeII_report.pdf (report), redwood_soc2_typeII_bridge_letter.pdf (draft), evidence_manifest_minimal.csv

If you need anything redacted or require a narrower scope (e.g., only compute/ingress controls), let me know and we can prepare a scoped manifest.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

Attachments: redwood_soc2_typeII_bridge_letter.pdf; evidence_manifest_minimal.csv
